name: Productos — entrada de stock incrementa inventario
description: Tras iniciar sesión como admin, el usuario abre Productos, registra una entrada de stock para un producto existente y ve el inventario actualizado en el detalle.

planSteps.description: Sign in with the admin email and password configured for this project
Open the Productos section from the sidebar navigation
Open the action to add a stock entry (entrada de stock)
Select an existing product, set quantity to 1, and submit the stock entry form
Open the product detail or list row for the product that received the entry
Verify the product stock quantity shown in the products detail or list is greater than before the entry, or the entradas de stock table includes a new row with quantity 1
